definitions.explanation: A specialized classroom in a school equipped for conducting science experiments and lessons.

examples.japanese: {理科室|りかしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{実験|じっけん}→実験：03273_jikken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To do an experiment in the science lab.

examples.japanese: {理科室|りかしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{顕微鏡|けんびきょう}→顕微鏡：05482_kenbikyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are many microscopes in the science lab.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{理科室|りかしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{楽|たの}しそう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{化学|かがく}→化学：05336_kagaku_chem⟧⟦{実験|じっけん}→実験：03273_jikken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The children were happily doing chemistry experiments in the science lab.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{理科|りか}→理科：03994_rika⟧ (science, as a school subject) + ⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧ (room). Found in elementary and middle schools in Japan. Unlike regular classrooms, the {理科室|りかしつ} typically has special desks with gas taps and sinks, along with storage for lab equipment.

- {理科室|りかしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{器具|きぐ}→器具：03980_kigu⟧: science lab equipment
